parole.testo: Calque of Latin soliloquium or Byzantine Greek μονόλογος (monólogos). Equivalent to alleen (“alone”) + spraak (“speech”).

parole.significato: Melkite (in 5th-century Syria and Egypt, sobriquet applied to Chalcedonians)
